q: Every child has a fundamental right to ____. (P4)
explain: International and constitutional conventions guarantee children basic rights to schooling and safety.

q: The supreme legal document that guides how a country is governed is the ____. (P4)
explain: The Constitution is the supreme law of the land.

q: A good leader must demonstrate ____. (P4)
explain: Effective leadership requires accountability and public service.

q: Love for one's country and willingness to serve it is called ____. (P4)
explain: Patriotism is devoted civic commitment to the nation.

q: Civic duty (P4): Paying taxes promptly to the government is a civic ____.
explain: duty / obligation is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P4): Protecting public utilities like streetlights and water pipes is the responsibility of ____.
explain: all citizens is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P4): A citizen should always obey lawful orders from the ____.
explain: police and courts is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P4): Treating people of different ethnic groups and religions with kindness is called ____.
explain: tolerance and unity is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P4): Which of these is a civic responsibility of a student in school?
explain: Keeping the school compound clean is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P4): A child's right to life, healthcare, and education is protected by the ____ Act.
explain: Child Rights is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P4): When singing the National Anthem, citizens should ____.
explain: stand upright and pay attention is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P4): The Independent Corrupt Practices Commission is abbreviated as ____.
explain: ICPC is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P4): Refusing to join secret cults and violence in school demonstrates moral ____.
explain: courage and discipline is the essential civic principle.

q: Civic duty (P4): The National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) was established in 1973 to promote national ____.
explain: unity and integration is the essential civic principle.
